MERA INTROPPT WALA BANDA

Akshat Kumar

Ye hain Akshat Kumar — group ke woh bande jinse presentation banwani ho toh yaad kar lo. Inki zubaan par “sorry” aur “thank you” aise rehta hai jaise complimentary words nahi, subscription ho.

Pehchaan: “Sharif insaan hoon (sirf dikhne mein).”

Favourite dialogue: “Aayein?”

Khaas aadatein: Bina kisi zaroorat ke sorry bolna, aur bina kisi ehsaan ke thank you keh dena.

Yaadgaar kissa: Akshit aur Aniket ke saath scooty par ghar ja rahe the. Girre teeno, lekin chot sirf Akshat ko lagi. Kismat bhi boli hogi — “isko hi pakdo.” 😭

Andar ki baat: “Mere andar aaj bhi ek Deep ki Mala hai, but you are not nerdy enough to understand this.”

MERA DOSTGROUP KA JANAMDATA

Nitish Tripathi

Ye hain Nitish Tripathi — hamare WhatsApp aur Insta group ke janamdata. Projects banate rehte hain aur internships ke liye itne applications bhejte hain ki internship bhi soch rahi hogi, “bhai ab bas bhi kar.”

Pehchaan: Innocent si shakal, lekin reels aisi bhejte hain ki phone kholne se pehle parental guidance zaroori lagti hai.

Favourite dialogue: “Bisi.”

Khaas aadatein: Sone mein inka koi competition nahi. Alarm bhi baj-baj ke thak jaata hoga, par Nitish ji ki neend nahi toot-ti.

Yaadgaar kissa: Ek baar professor ko bataya ki Gorakhpur se Jamshedpur aane mein 4 din lag gaye. Bhai college aa rahe the ya India tour karke aaye the?

Andar ki baat: Akriti ke peeche ek alag hi mission mode chalta hai, aur 2 back clear karne ka ghamand abhi bhi full charge mein hai. 😭

MERA DOSTHANDSOME BUT REJECTED

Aniket Upadhyay

Ye hain Aniket Upadhyay — Tata Steel mein reject hone ka dard alag hi level ka hai, woh bhi jab poora khandaan Tata Steel mein ho. Rishtedaari full power, selection phir bhi zero. 😭

Pehchaan: Ladka handsome toh hai. Group ka eklauta banda jiske paas saamne se proposal aata hai. Filhaal “Are tree” par committed hain.

Favourite dialogue: “Gand tod denge hum tera!”

Khaas aadat: Jab bhi padhne baithte hain, potty ka emergency alarm baj jaata hai. Kitaab khulti nahi ki washroom ka attendance lag jaata hai. 🚽

Yaadgaar kissa: Bina kisi technical club ka member hue Joint Tech Secretary banne chale the. Confidence dekho — eligibility baad mein, election pehle.

Academic plot twist: Summer short mein back clear karke class ke topper se bhi zyada grade le aaye. Kaise saala? Aaj tak investigation jaari hai.

Andar ki baat: “Are tree” par committed toh hain, par bhai LinkedIn par profile picture toh laga hi sakta hai na be! Corporate duniya ko bhi pata chale handsome kaun hai. 😂

MERA DOSTUDTA TEER SPECIALIST

Pratyush Kumar Bhar

Ye hain Pratyush Kumar Bhar — filhaal M.Tech ki taiyari kar rahe hain, lekin dil mein gamer banne ka sapna abhi bhi zinda hai. Udta teer lene ki kala mein inka koi jawaab nahi. 😭

Pehchaan: Hostel ka paisa kyun de rahe hain, jab aadha time ghar par hi rehte hain? Aur phir wapas aake poochte hain — “Bakchodi miss kaise ho gayi?” Bhai, attendance ghar se lagwa lete!

Favourite dialogue: “Aao sex krte hai!”

Khaas aadat: Bina maange musibat ko invite karna. Udta teer dekhte hi pakadna inka natural instinct hai.

Yaadgaar kissa: Inse dosti Machine Workshop mein hui, jab ye meri file kar rahe the. Pata nahi kaunsi alag hi technique thi — workshop kam, inki harkatein zyada yaad reh gayin. 😂

Andar ki baat: Khushi ke saath committed toh hain, par udta teer lene ki wajah se dukhi hi rehte hain. Bhai, apni chutiya harkatein thodi sudhaar le, zindagi khud-b-khud mast ho jayegi. 💀

MERA DOSTDODDI NARESH FAN CLUB

Ankit Agrahari

Ye hain Ankit Agrahari — apne hometown Doddi Naresh ke naam se itne emotionally attached hain ki koi bas bol de “haan bhai, jaanta hoon”, toh bhai ki khushi ka thikana nahi rehta. 😭

Pehchaan: Kaafi Tejaswi hain (iykyk), aur inke doubts aur questions simple nahi hote — proper nested if-else mein chalte hain. Jawab dene se pehle flowchart banana padta hai.

Favourite dialogue: “Kitna Thul Thul hai be.”

Khaas aadat: Joke chhod deta hai saala — doubts pooch pooch ke! Inke questions ka silsila shuru ho jaaye toh lagta hai professor ka viva chal raha hai. 😭

Yaadgaar kissa: Phone kharidne ke liye ek hi din mein hum sabse 4 trips karwa di. Itna ghumane ke baad ghar jaake phone kharida. Bhai, ek baar mein decide kar leta — hum log shopping ke saath pilgrimage pe nahi nikle the! 😭

Andar ki baat: Banda mast hai. MES President ban jaaye toh apna hi alag swag hoga. Aur bhai, non-core mein job lag jayegi — tension mat le, bas phone ki tarah career ke options mein 4 trips mat lagwa dena. 😂

MERA DOSTCGPA KA RAAZ

Akshit Yadav

Ye hain Akshit Yadav — exam se ek raat pehle hamare saath padhai shuru karte hain, par result aate hi CGPA aisi nikalti hai jaise poore semester library mein tent laga ke baithe ho. Baaki hum abhi bhi is academic scam ki investigation kar rahe hain. 😭

Pehchaan: Yadav ji dil ke saaf aadmi hain aur jigyasa (jigisha nahi be!) hamesha full power mein rehti hai. Har cheez jaan-ni hai — bas exam se pehle padhai ka secret abhi tak disclose nahi kiya. 😂

Favourite dialogue: “Kya be bakchodi mat karo, nahi toh yahin gaand phaad denge!”

Khaas aadat: Inki bhook ka koi end-credit scene hi nahi aata. Jo bhi saamne aa jaaye, pet mein jagah mil hi jaati hai. Plate khaali ho sakti hai, Yadav ji ki appetite nahi. 😭

Yaadgaar kissa: Aadhi raat ko 4 loading karke, bina dekhe night-out par nikalwa diya. Bhai ka confidence itna tha ki pehle adventure shuru kiya, baad mein check kiya ki scene safe bhi hai ya nahi. 💀

Andar ki baat: Yadav ji, dil ke saaf ho aur bande ek number. Bas California pahunch ke accent badal lena, dosti nahi. Aur haan, wahan se bhi group ki bakchodi mein online attendance lagate rehna. 😂

MERA DOSTJUPITER KA RAJA

Sayan Mukherjee

Ye hain Sayan Mukherjee — group ke eklaute dancer, aur technically Jupiter bhi. Kyunki “sabki apni-apni aankhein, sabka apna-apna chaand; Sayan apna Jupiter, iske 25 chaand.” Astronomy department bhi itna personal nahi hua jitna hum ho gaye. 😭

Pehchaan: “I am different” bolkar IC election mein apni alag hi branding kar di thi. Bhai, confidence toh dekho — apni category khud bana li. 😂

Favourite dialogue: “Mereko Aman ke saath sex krna hai.”

Khaas aadat: Charger maangne mein itne consistent hain ki inka naam contact list mein “Power Bank ka dushman” save hona chahiye. Apna charger kab kharidenge, woh abhi suspense hai.

Yaadgaar kissa: IC election ke time “I am different” wala statement dekar poori campaign ko ek hi dialogue mein wrap kar diya. Baaki candidates manifesto laaye, Sayan tagline le aaye. 💀

Andar ki baat: Bhai ki fan-following abhi Civil aur Mechanical first year tak pahunchi hui hai — bas apni popularity ko decent rakho, ECM ko bhi target audience mat bana dena. Aur ek baat: Rohit Sharma toh Ritika ke saath loyal hain; baaki apni life ka match tu dekh le, bhai. 😂

MERA DOSTGATE SE SAB HO JAYEGA

Aman Tiwari

Ye hain Aman Tiwari — inka maanna hai ki GATE nikal gaya toh zindagi ki saari problems apne aap solve ho jayengi. Baaki duniya backup plan banaye, Aman bhai ka bharosa seedha GATE par hai. 😭

Pehchaan: GATE ke bharose itne confident hain ki LinkedIn ki taraf dekhna bhi zaroori nahi samajhte. Career ka GPS ek hi destination dikha raha hai.

Favourite dialogue: “Mere mama dekh lenge.”

Khaas aadat: Kisi se bhi bakchodi kar lenge aur bina warning kuch bhi bol denge. Inke muh se kya nikalne wala hai, iska prediction NASA bhi nahi kar sakta. 😂

Yaadgaar kissa: Is incident par zyada kuch nahi bolenge — bas itna samajh lo, Aditya inke liye sabse bada dushman hai. Baaki kahaani kabhi group meeting mein. 👀

Andar ki baat: Abe GATE ke din Kajal ka kaala tika laga lena, nazar na lag jaaye! Itna confidence hai toh thoda nazar battu bhi zaroori hai, samjha na be? 😂
